scope.zh: 本版是可见配色偏好的原创趣味问卷，不是肤色或外观诊断。不收集照片、肤色、静脉、发色、眼色、日晒反应、种族或他人评价，不推断专业四季归属、健康、颜值、人格或职业匹配，也不承诺某种衣服或首饰一定显气色。春夏秋冬只是四组示例配色名称，具体颜色为本站原创选择，不复刻任何专业品牌色表。结果只读这次菜单中的偏好；色块、名称和色号都供比较，不是购买建议。
scope.en: This is an original playful questionnaire about visible palette preferences, not complexion or appearance diagnosis. It collects no photograph, skin tone, veins, hair, eyes, sun response, ethnicity or other people’s appraisals, and infers no professional season assignment, health, attractiveness, personality or career fit. It promises no flattering effect from clothes or jewellery. The seasons name four example palettes with original colour choices, replicating no professional brand chart. Results concern these menus. Blocks, names and colour codes support comparison rather than purchasing advice.

instructions.zh: 只比较每题实际显示的三色色块与名称，色块面积和排列一致；选这次更愿意看的组合，不根据理想季节、肤色或别人评价选。16题完整后显示原始选择次数，所有最高并列保留全文。四组是本站原创示例配色，不是专业色表或对你的外观分析；没有视觉判断或没有选项合适，可以停止，四份完整指南始终开放。
instructions.en: Compare the three colour blocks and names actually shown in each item, with equal areas and arrangement. Choose the combination you prefer to view this time, not an ideal season, complexion or another person’s judgment. All sixteen choices produce raw counts, retaining every highest tie in full. Four groups are original example palettes, not professional colour charts or an analysis of your appearance. Stop if visual judgment is unavailable or nothing fits; every full guide remains open.
